landing.heroDesc: Ask about badges, camp safety, rules and field craft. ARPO answers from the manuals your troop already trusts, and shows you the page it came from.

specimen.label: Example
specimen.question: What should every patrol pack for a monsoon camp?
specimen.answerIntro: Start from the standard patrol kit list, then plan for the ground staying wet:

steps.one: A groundsheet under every tent, not only inside it
steps.two: Spare guy lines, kept dry in a sealed bag
steps.three: One full change of clothes per scout, bagged separately
steps.four: Dry kindling carried in, since fallen wood won’t light

features.title: The reference shelf, carried to the campsite.
features.desc: Leaders upload the documents once. Everyone in the troop can ask questions of them from then on.

manuals.title: Grounded in your manuals
manuals.description: Every answer is drawn from the BSG handbooks and rulebooks your team uploads, not from the open internet.

badges.title: Badge paths, spelled out
badges.description: From Pravesh to Rajya Puraskar, get the requirements for a badge as a clear sequence of steps.

fieldcraft.title: Field craft on the spot
fieldcraft.description: Knots, pitching in the rain, first aid on a hike. Ask from the campsite and get a straight answer.

sources.title: Sources you can check
sources.description: Each reply lists the document and page it came from, so a leader can verify it before a scout acts on it.

footer.service: © 2026 ARPO · An independent prototype built for Bharat Scouts & Guides
footer.disclaimer: Answers are drawn from manuals uploaded by troop leaders. Check safety-critical advice with your leader.

trail.title: Every camp starts with a good question.
trail.two: See the page it came from
trail.quote: “Try and leave this world a little better than you found it.”
